purpose: Preserve contradiction history while preventing superseded discovery findings from contaminating current boundary arithmetic.

adjudications.original_finding: No frozen Skywatcher Centinelas consumer adapter/receipt gate located.
adjudications.reason: The frozen/current Skywatcher head contains `.github/workflows/centinelas-handoff.yml` and `scripts/ingest_centinelas_handoff.py`. Search coverage produced a false negative.
adjudications.replacement_finding: The consumer existed but treated receipt existence as sufficient replay identity: same idempotency key with changed protected payload was not collision-tested, and consumer-side bounded signal validation was absent.

remediation.head: fd4dfef237137e44933aa33ffdd1c8418824c42b
remediation.candidate_effect: Adds deterministic-key verification for new receipts, exact-replay idempotency, same-key/different-payload collision evidence and failure, bounded consumer validation, legacy-receipt replay compatibility, identity_effect=NONE, and persistence of collision evidence even on ingest failure.

adjudications.original_finding: MoneySweep emits a four-file consumer bundle while Spiderweb expects an eleven-artifact manifest; potential producer/consumer shape incompatibility.
adjudications.reason: The contracts are layered: Spiderweb consumes the four required scored-layer inputs; the eleven-artifact manifest is an optional upstream integrity/readiness gate.
adjudications.replacement_finding: The committed MoneySweep integrity manifest embedded producer commit 17c21ac2f3675895d890bf51a508167de50943c9 while current main/frozen remediation evidence uses b16cf315e76531a29c7048301986d42f26adc010, and Spiderweb originally required only a nonempty commit rather than an exact expected producer revision.
adjudications.byte_adjudication: All eleven artifact Git blob identities were reverified unchanged at MoneySweep main b16cf315e76531a29c7048301986d42f26adc010, so producer-manifest rebinding is provenance-only and does not change evidence bytes.

remediation.head: cc5b4f3ec17e8c30aaafede43c7c4efa034d9095
remediation.candidate_effect: Rebinds producer.commit to exact current main while preserving all artifact blob pins.

remediation.head: c8e0db626d1bb589fd692321c46e62e2ba411ac0
remediation.candidate_effect: Adds exact expected-producer-commit enforcement and requires manifest/expected-commit pairing at the operator CLI boundary.

adjudications.original_finding: PR #279 treated 0:1 and UNRESOLVED as values in one cardinality enum and accepted `fed_<32hex>` authority IDs.
adjudications.reason: PR #258's locked federation-spatial-entity/1.0 draft defines only 1:1, 1:N, N:1 and N:N as identity cardinalities, UNRESOLVED as an identity state, and canonical IDs as FED-SPATIAL-PR-%08d.

remediation.head: f7234505b207b113198119e3994b13b96f4cfeae
remediation.candidate_effect: Separates identity cardinality, resolution state and non-identity crosswalk shape; rejects old hash-form IDs; preserves evidence polarity and fail-closed identity semantics.
